title: Design System: Arai Hû Asset Calibration Bench

narrative.overview: Exact-size device and browser proofs expose optical problems while the interface recedes into paired paper and midnight work surfaces.

rules.name: Signal Ration
rules.body: Lime indicates current state or a review finding, never ambient ornament.

dos: Show transparent assets on solid and checker surfaces.
Keep exact size labels adjacent to specimens.
donts: Judge only from large container-width artwork.
Compensate for weak geometry with CSS scaling.
